ROBOT KNIGHT: Apprentice P N Wong stated that after obtaining a forward position in the early stages her mount failed to respond to her riding and raced "flat”.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SO MY FOLKS: Making the turn near the 600 Metres MR GOOD VIBES shifted out, resulting in SO MY FOLKS improving to the inside of MR GOOD VIBES.  A short distance later MR GOOD VIBES shifted in to resume its position, resulting in SO MY FOLKS having to be steadied.  SO MY FOLKS then had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching the 400 Metres.
HAPPY ACTION: Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres lay in and had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted out.  Again near the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of SO MY FOLKS.
ONLY U: Jumped only fairly, shifted out and was steadied to avoid HAPPY ACTION.
WAVE GARDEN: Jumped awkwardly.  When questioned regarding the improved performance Trainer C W Chang stated that the horse was advantaged by being down in grade and also appreciated having its first race start on the All Weather surface.  Sent for sampling post-race.
VON BAER: When caught wide in the early stages was steadied to obtain a position with cover behind WAVE GARDEN.  Leaving the 600 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied to avoid WAVE GARDEN.  M F Poon stated that he was instructed to obtain cover on the horse which resulted in VON BAER settling back in the field.  He said after obtaining a position with cover VON BAER found it difficult to make up ground from that position, particularly when the pace of the race quickened from the 500 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HANDSOME BLOND: Jumped awkwardly.  In the early stages got its head up when being steadied to obtain cover.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
TURF PHOENIX: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
NOT USUAL DOUBLE: Bumped on jumping.  Passing the 200 Metres was eased and shifted to the outside of LITTLE MONSTER to continue into clear running.
DAILY FUN: Jumped awkwardly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RYUI KOKOROE: Near the 1100 Metres was eased when momentarily crowded by SOO KOO which shifted in and away from NAVAS G.  Approaching the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving between JUST FOLLOW ME and GLACIATED.  Near the 100 Metres RYUI KOKOROE, which was laying in, was eased to avoid JUST FOLLOW ME which shifted out slightly.  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that RYUI KOKOROE had bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, RYUI KOKOROE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GLACIATED: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  C Y Ho was fined the sum of $5,000 for returning to scale in excess of 2 lbs overweight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, GLACIATED will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DOUBLE BINGO: Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with PRINCE ALEX.  Approaching the 1300 Metres shifted in and away from PRINCE ALEX and as a result was eased to avoid DRACO.
STORMY KNIGHT: Jumped only fairly.  L Ferraris stated that his mount was disadvantaged by racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SWAGGER BRO: Near the 150 Metres was checked when crowded between DRACO (K C Leung) which shifted out slightly before being corrected by its rider and ALWAYS FLUKE (H Bentley) which, when laying in, shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  H Bentley was advised in similar circumstances he should exercise more care and straighten his mounts sooner than what he did on this occasion.
ALWAYS FLUKE: Lay in in the Home Straight and near the 150 Metres was corrected by H Bentley.  Jockey Bentley could offer no explanation for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AQUAMAN: Jumped only fairly.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.
DRACO: Near the 150 Metres shifted out when obtaining a run to the outside of BLUE BARON, resulting in K C Leung having to stop riding and straighten his mount.  Sent for sampling post-race.
PRINCE ALEX: Shortly after the start was crowded between DOUBLE BINGO and BLUE BARON, both of which shifted ground slightly.
RAPID PHANTOM: Shifted out on jumping and made contact with COMET RADIANCE.  Hung out under pressure between the 300 Metres and the 100 Metres.  Apprentice P N Wong (ZOUPER FELLOW) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 50 Metres whilst riding her mount out, she allowed ZOUPER FELLOW to shift in when not sufficiently clear of RAPID PHANTOM, contributing to RAPID PHANTOM having to be checked.  Apprentice Wong was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 14 October 2026 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered her very good race riding record.  C L Chau (FLOWING RICHES) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 50 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when not sufficiently clear of RAPID PHANTOM, contributing to RAPID PHANTOM having to be checked.  C L Chau was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 7 October 2026 at Happy Valley.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  In considering both penalties, the Stewards took into account the contribution due to the shift from both horses.
RUN RUN SUNRISE: Bumped on a number of occasions between the 900 Metres and the 800 Metres.  K C Leung could offer no explanation for his mount failing to finish the race off over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
KINGMAN REEF: Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was checked when crowded between COMET RADIANCE which was taken out by RAPID PHANTOM and HERO MASTERMIND which shifted in.  Over the final 100 Metres could not be ridden out when held up between SHOW ME YOUR LOVE and RUN RUN SUNRISE.
HERO MASTERMIND: Shifted in on jumping and made contact with KINGMAN REEF.  Near the 250 Metres was steadied to avoid COMET RADIANCE which shifted out and away from FLOWING RICHES.  HERO MASTERMIND then had difficulty obtaining clear running for a short distance thereafter.
FLOWING RICHES: C L Chau was found guilty of a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 50 Metres (see RAPID PHANTOM).  Sent for sampling post-race.
THUNDER PRINCE: Bumped on a number of occasions between the 900 Metres and the 800 Metres.  Over the final 200 Metres lay out and proved difficult to ride.
SHOW ME YOUR LOVE: Approaching the 100 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of THUNDER PRINCE to obtain clear running.
ZOUPER FELLOW: Noted to have blood in the mouth on arrival at the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and found suitable to race.  Apprentice P N Wong pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 50 Metres (see RAPID PHANTOM).  Sent for sampling post-race.
LET'S HAVE FUN: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 400 Metres was steadied and shifted to the inside of FLYING TING LOK to obtain clear running.
CAUSEWAY KING: Shifted out at the start, resulting in its rider having to correct her mount.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CENTRAL BANK: Near the 500 Metres was steadied to avoid M M CONCORD.
WATCH LEGEND: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NATURAL HIGH: Near the 700 Metres was eased to avoid M M CONCORD which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
BRIGHT MORTAR: Slow to begin.  Sent for sampling post-race.
M M CONCORD: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
NOBLE DELUXE: Hampered on jumping.  A Atzeni stated that his intention was to hold a more forward position but his mount did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to do so.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.  The performance of NOBLE DELUXE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, NOBLE DELUXE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
RAGING WARRIOR: Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was hampered when taken out by NOBLE DELUXE which was taken out by CAUSEWAY KING.  Raced greenly throughout the early stages and near the 800 Metres became unbalanced when momentarily crowded between DASHING PEACH and NOBLE DELUXE which shifted in slightly.
DASHING PEACH: Bumped at the start.  The performance of DASHING PEACH, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DASHING PEACH will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
DAY DAY VICTORY: Withdrawn on 26.9.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter RAGING WARRIOR.  Before being allowed to race again, DAY DAY VICTORY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
ETALON OR: Raced wide and without cover until near the 600 Metres. <28/9/2026 Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Surgeon reported that ETALON OR had a right front tendon injury on the day after racing. Before being allowed to race again, ETALON OR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
TURIN CHAMPIONS: On the Home Turn was hampered when taken wider by LUCKY MAN which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CIRCUIT FIERY: Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up behind HAROLD WIN.
HAROLD WIN: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
BUCEPHALAS: Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was eased when crowded between HOT AIR BALLON and CHIU CHOW GOLF, both of which shifted ground.  Approaching the 1300 Metres improved to the inside of HOT AIR BALLON as HOT AIR BALLON was shifting in.  As a result BUCEPHALAS was steadied when crowded by HOT AIR BALLON.  Noted to have lost its right front plate after the race.
LUCKY MAN: Near the 1150 Metres, when racing keenly, was steadied to avoid HAROLD WIN (C L Chau) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  C L Chau was reprimanded.  LUCKY MAN continued to race keenly in the middle stages.
GOLDEN GUNNERS: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
HOT AIR BALLON: Jumped only fairly.  Between the 400 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running.  Over the final 100 Metres then had difficulty obtaining clear running when attempting to improve between SUPER LOVE and GHORGAN.
WORD OF KINDNESS: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AURORA PATCH: C Y Ho stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but after jumping only fairly and being crowded shortly after the start between PACKING KING and DEVAS TWELVE his mount settled further back in the field than intended.  Trainer K L Man confirmed the instructions issued.
MIGHTY COMMANDER: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 700 Metres was bumped by ALL’S WELL and as a result became unbalanced.
RIDING TOGETHER: Became unbalanced when badly crowded near the 600 Metres.
ALL'S WELL: Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the 700 Metres commenced to race keenly and as a result shifted out and became unbalanced when it made contact with MIGHTY COMMANDER.
FOUR STARS ALIGN: Y L Chung pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 600 Metres (see PACKING KING).  Shifted out near the 350 Metres and became unbalanced when it made contact with SPEEDY SMARTIE.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Y L Chung was questioned in relation to his riding out of the horse to the finish and in particular the final two strides of the event where he stopped riding.  Jockey Chung stated that approaching the winning post he heard a call from a rider positioned to his inside and for this reason he stopped riding and placed pressure on his left rein to prevent FOUR STARS ALIGN from shifting in.  After considering his evidence and viewing the patrol films the Stewards accepted the explanation provided by Jockey Chung, however, he was advised, wherever possible, to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.
HOTT SHOTT: Near the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid PACKING KING.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PACKING KING: E C W Wong was fined the sum of $5,000 for a breach of Rule 89(2) in that he changed his riding breeches and boots after weighing out.  Y L Chung (FOUR STARS ALIGN) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 600 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of RIDING TOGETHER, resulting in RIDING TOGETHER, PACKING KING and DEVAS TWELVE being badly crowded for room and also causing PACKING KING to be checked.  Y L Chung was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Sunday, 4 October 2026 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record.  Jockey Wong stated that after being checked near the 600 Metres his mount failed to run on thereafter.  The performance of PACKING KING, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PACKING KING will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SPEEDY SMARTIE: Near the 350 Metres FOUR STARS ALIGN shifted out and made contact with SPEEDY SMARTIE which was taken wider.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HERBAL STAR: Withdrawn on 26.9.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter ENDURANCE EXPRESS.  Before being allowed to race again, HERBAL STAR will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GALAXY PATCH: Jumped awkwardly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
HELIOS EXPRESS: A Atzeni stated that after settling back in the field he was satisfied with the horse’s finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PATCH OF THETA: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 900 Metres commenced to race keenly and shifted out when being steadied to avoid STORMY GROVE.
LITTLE PARADISE: Near the 1200 Metres was steadied when crowded by SOLEIL FIGHTER (H Bentley) which shifted in before being corrected.  H Bentley was advised to exercise more care.  Approaching the 400 Metres was hampered when bumped by LUCKY WITH YOU which shifted out to improve.  Near the 100 Metres was hampered when momentarily crowded by INVINCIBLE IBIS which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  Z Purton stated that his mount responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight but could offer no excuse for the performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
STORMY GROVE: Near the 900 Metres shifted out slightly when being steadied to avoid LITTLE PARADISE.
LUCKY WITH YOU: Approaching the 400 Metres shifted out in an attempt to improve and made contact with LITTLE PARADISE.
AMAZING PARTNERS: Crowded shortly after the start.  Near the 350 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of SHAMUS STORM as that runner was shifting out.  As a consequence AMAZING PARTNERS shifted out further, making slight contact with NUCLEOZOR.  Sent for sampling post-race.
FALLON: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SOLID WIN: Shifted in at the start, made contact with the right side of the starting gate and then was bumped shortly after the start.  Near the 400 Metres blundered when laying in and reluctant to shift to the outside of VOYAGE HORIZON.
FLYING LUCK: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VIOLET STAR: L Ferraris reported that his mount jumped only fairly but then blundered shortly after the start when it was crowded between AMAZING PARTNERS and SOLID WIN.
BIG RETURN: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Briefly crowded near the 900 Metres by VOYAGE HORIZON which shifted in before being corrected.  Near the 350 Metres was hampered when taken wider by MISTER DAPPER which shifted out.
VOYAGE HORIZON: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  The performance of VOYAGE HORIZON, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, VOYAGE HORIZON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
FLYING KNIGHT: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
QUANTUM LEGEND: Approaching the 350 Metres was briefly held up for clear running.  Between the 250 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
WINNING GOLD: Withdrawn on 26.9.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter VOYAGE HORIZON.  Before being allowed to race again, WINNING GOLD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
MUGEN: Jumped only fairly.  Over the final 100 Metres could not be fully tested when improving behind SALON S.
RISING FORCE: Z Purton stated that he was satisfied with the horse’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SKY TRUST: Bumped shortly after the start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea and also found it to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.  Before being allowed to race again, SKY TRUST will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
AERIS NOVA: Bumped at the start.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
SALON S: Bumped at the start.  Lay in over the final 200 Metres.
GENEVA: Shortly after the start was bumped by SKY TRUST.  When questioned A Atzeni stated that he expected GENEVA to settle back in the field and he had been instructed to hold the horse for a final run as GENEVA possess a short sprint.  He said after holding a rearward position, entering the Home Straight he encouraged the horse forward but did not apply full pressure having regard to his instructions.  He said his decision to do so was also influenced by the fact that TURQUOISE VELOCITY and VICTOR THE WINNER had gone quickly in front and he expected those horses to give ground in the Home Straight.  He added that when he approached the 300 Metres he then placed GENEVA under full pressure following the favourite RISING FORCE into the event before the horse finished the race off well over the concluding stages.  Trainer D J Hall confirmed the instructions, however, stated that, in his view, he would like to have seen the horse being placed under pressure sooner than it was on this occasion.  After considering his explanation the Stewards advised Jockey Atzeni that, in their opinion, he should have placed more pressure on the horse in the early stages of the Home Straight to improve his position, particularly having regard to the margin he was behind the leaders.  He was further advised in future he would be expected to ride his mounts with better judgement than he did on this occasion.
PAKISTAN LEGACY: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GLOWING PRAISES: Raced keenly in the middle stages and near the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid RISING FORCE (Z Purton) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  Z Purton was advised to exercise more care.
LUCKY SAM GOR: Between the 350 Metres and the 200 Metres was held up for clear running.
BEAUTY CRESCENT: Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of Y L Chung, 6th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, he was nonetheless reminded of his obligation to ensure that he fully rides his mounts out to the finish of the race.  Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
COMPLETE UNKNOWN: Near the 300 Metres K Teetan had his whip accidentally knocked from his grasp by the whip of R Kingscote, rider of PRIME SUCCESS.  K Teetan stated that his instructions were to go forward.  He said as a result he was obliged to make use of the horse in the early stages to cross runners to his inside, however, was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added that in the Home Straight COMPLETE UNKNOWN was then unable to finish the race off.   A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
ENDEARED: A Atzeni stated that his mount, which was racing first up today, finished the race off in a one-paced manner in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FORZA TORO: As L Ferraris was unable to make the weight, L Hewitson was substituted as the rider of FORZA TORO.  Jockey Ferraris was fined the sum of $5,000.
PRIME SUCCESS: Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with DRAGON JOY.
THE BOOM BOX: Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with THUNDER BLAZE.  When questioned C Y Ho stated that after making contact with THUNDER BLAZE at the start his saddle shifted back, placing him at a disadvantage throughout the early and middle stages.  He said for this reason he was not able to apply full pressure to THE BOOM BOX in an endeavour to improve its position at the tail of the field.  He added that upon entering the Home Straight when he was satisfied THE BOOM BOX was balanced, whilst his saddle was still back, he was able to commence to ride the horse along where THE BOOM BOX finished the race off strongly in the Home Straight.
DRAGON JOY: Jumped awkwardly and then shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by PRIME SUCCESS.  Raced keenly in the middle stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
